digest: Gold for the coming week splits the room: Claude, Gemini and Grok would buy on dips, while Wenxin, Step 5 Preview and MiMo would trim. ChatGPT and DeepSeek sit it out.
Claude stands alone on tech stocks. It would buy Nasdaq-100 and chip stocks on dips, while ChatGPT, Gemini, MiMo and DeepSeek trim, and Wenxin goes further and sells.
The most surprising call is Wenxin's. It is the only one that would buy oil hard today, for both WTI and Brent, while most others just hold.
Claude also goes against the crowd on fear: it bets the VIX will fall, while ChatGPT, Gemini and others bet it will rise, and DeepSeek bets on a big jump.
They all agree on US 10-year yields over the week except Claude. Everyone else bets they rise, and nearly all would simply hold the Dow, the dollar, gold, oil and copper today.
